data.name: Jishu
data.gender_notes: Jishu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jishu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jish', which means 'truth'. In Hindu mythology, Jishu is considered the embodiment of truth and wisdom. The name Jishu carries the meaning “God is truth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jishu usually hope their child will grow to embody god is truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jishu is a sacred name in Hinduism, believed to be associated with the deity Ganesha, the god of wisdom and knowledge. The name is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, knowledge, and intelligence to the bearer.
data.etymology: Jishu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jishu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

In some Hindu communities, people recite the name of Jishu as a mantra or use it as a sacred syllable during meditation and rituals.
